scope: deepen the existing M1 canonical PlanCompiler::compile path for depth-aware supplied plans and deterministic bounded multi-task DAGs
strengthen PlanValidator contracts required by M3-T02 without introducing a second planning or execution authority
preserve M1 compiler behavior through m3: None compatibility at all legacy call sites
compile/validate multi-repository plans only; Controller production execution authority remains single-repository until M8

canonical_compiler_contract.single_path: M3 is an optional PlanCompilationInput.m3 extension inside the same PlanCompiler::compile introduced by M1-T10; no parallel compiler or planning authority exists.
canonical_compiler_contract.m1_compatibility: All legacy M1/controller/eval call sites use m3: None; legacy compiler fixtures remain green and M3-only CompilationEvidence fields are omitted from legacy serialization.
canonical_compiler_contract.validator_authority: Every normalized candidate remains subject to PlanValidator; supplied human/external/model plans cannot bypass validation.
canonical_compiler_contract.repair_policy: At most one bounded validator/proposal repair is possible when the caller/model budget permits the second compiler call; no hidden planner retry path exists.

depth_contract.persistence: DepthDecision is serialized verbatim into Plan IR depth; PlanCompiler does not recompute or replace it.
depth_contract.task_cap: effective task count is the minimum of deterministic depth cap, authoritative policy.retry.max_tasks_per_revision, and the hard M3 compiler ceiling.

dag_contract.authoritative_graph: task.dependencies[] is the sole hard dependency DAG
dag_contract.topology: BTree-backed deterministic topological normalization produces stable ordering and IDs from goal/repository/context/depth identity.
dag_contract.dependency_bindings: Every hard dependency has exactly one dependency_binding, and validator resolution requires its upstream artifact/criterion targets to exist and be required contracts.
dag_contract.supplemental_edges: top-level edges[] are derived produces_for relationships only and do not create a second hard DAG.

trust_and_evidence_contract.untrusted_proposal_surface: M3 proposal structs and JSON schema deny unknown fields and expose no policy, permission, tool, pin, activation, approval, grant, external-authority, or side-effect-authority fields.
trust_and_evidence_contract.authoritative_fields: Normalization copies caller-owned policy/role/skills and only caller-pinned tools; proposal content cannot widen them.
trust_and_evidence_contract.supplied_source_binding: Supplied human/external/spec planning sources must resolve to bounded ContextPacket evidence by evidence_id plus exact source_digest and content_digest, and remain recorded as untrusted provenance.
trust_and_evidence_contract.unknown_paths: Unknown proposed paths are removed from executable scope, force bounded discovery/read-only behavior, and become explicit exact evidence requirements before mutation can proceed.
trust_and_evidence_contract.absence: Negative/absence claims normalize only to evaluator_pass using the caller-owned governed evaluator. query_completed records acquisition completion only and can never prove absence.
trust_and_evidence_contract.manual_acceptance: Manual criteria are accepted only when their gate ID already exists in caller-owned M3PlanningInput.manual_gates; an untrusted proposal cannot mint approval authority.

validator_contract.revision_and_replan_ceilings: Existing PlanValidator task/revision/replan budget checks remain authoritative.

compiled_plan_ir_fixture_corpus.proof: out-of-order multi-module tasks normalize to deterministic topo order with stable IDs, hard dependencies, and one-for-one required upstream bindings
DepthDecision persists verbatim and supplied human-plan provenance is exact source/content digest bound
deny-unknown malicious authority fields are rejected and only the bounded repair call can recover
absence is governed evaluator_pass while query_completed remains acquisition-only
unknown paths become execution-gating evidence rather than invented mutable scope
depth/policy/global task caps reject oversize plans without hidden model calls
PlanValidator-invalid candidate gets at most one budgeted repair before fail-closed rejection
caller-preauthorized manual gate succeeds and attacker-authored gate fails

plan_validator_diagnostics.accepted_supplied_plan: valid normalized supplied-plan fixtures produce a PlanValidator-clean Plan IR candidate
rejected_supplied_plan: unknown authority fields are proposal/schema rejected before normalization
missing/orphan/non-required dependency binding targets are rejected with DependencyBinding diagnostics
ungoverned evaluator references are rejected with EvidenceContract/AcceptanceContract diagnostics
orphan or non-bidirectional criterion-step links are rejected with AcceptanceContract diagnostics
duplicate verification step IDs are rejected with DuplicateId
unpreauthorized manual gates fail closed as proposal rejection

controller_boundary.execution_rule: Controller activation still accepts only compiler-owned PlanCompilationResult and rejects plans whose active scope contains anything other than exactly one repository; M3 multi-repository plans therefore compile/validate but remain execution-fail-closed until M8.
